mechanics_notes: 100-Ki Strike Super with a sword, single-hit and chargeable. The user jumps forward and slashes the target; holding the input causes the user to teleport directly to the locked-on opponent before the slash. Current documentation reports 10% damage and restricts the CaC version to Human and Saiyan races. Exact charge timing and frame data remain unresolved.
evidence_boundary: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence only; unresolved numerical/frame details remain bounded.
